force.description: Apply direct and close force or violence. Smash, fight, cut, grapple.

conditioning.description: Get around on foot. Sprint, climb, swim, balance.

coordination.description: Use your hand-eye coordination. Shoot, throw, catch.

covert.description: Move with stealth and act with sleight of hand. Sneak, lock pick, steal.

interfacing.description: Use, understand, build, or fix technology, vehicles, or devices. Drive, hack, repair.

investigation.description: Examine something in detail, or uncover information about it. Research, study, sleuth.

surveillance.description: Use your power of observation. Survey, track, spot.

negotiation.description: Rely on your words to influence others. Sway, lie, bargain.

authority.description: Wield your leadership and force of will. Lead, organize, order, intimidate.

connection.description: Connect to others, and draw on those connections. Intuit, empathize, network.

psyche.description: Govern the use of your psychic powers. Only roll it when using these powers.

Abilities.PsycheInfoP1: Using any blasphemy power requires a psyche burst. Some can spend multiple for extra benefit.
Abilities.PsycheInfoLi1: You can always spend a psyche burst to add +1 advantage die to any roll (yours or an ally's) by using your blasphemies in a creative way.
Abilities.PsycheInfoLi2: You always start a mission with three psyche bursts.
Abilities.PsycheInfoLi3: You can recover them by resting during a hunt (see pg. 38) or through the uses of abilities.
Abilities.PsycheInfoLi4: You can always use psyche for minor effects such as:
Abilities.PsycheInfoSubLi1: producing a faint light or aura around something or someone
Abilities.PsycheInfoSubLi2: producing minor force at a distance (like a gust of wind)
Abilities.PsycheInfoSubLi3: making electrical lights or appliances flicker
Abilities.PsycheInfoSubLi4: warm or cool the surface of your body

Homebrew.BondInfo1: Bonds represent a character's connection to a Virtue. As bonds level up (0-3), characters gain abilities.
Homebrew.BondInfo2: Strictures are rules that must be followed while bonding. Breaking them costs 1d3 stress.
Homebrew.BondInfo3: High Blasphemies are special powers gained at the specified bond level - they're "free" and don't increase XP cap.
Homebrew.BondInfo4: Bond Abilities should be created separately using the Bond Abilities tab, then linked to this bond.

Homebrew.ExportFolderSelectHint: Select custom subfolders inside your homebrew items directory to export them as folders containing JSON files. This is recommended if you have a lot of items.
Homebrew.ImportFileHint: Select a JSON file containing exported CAIN items to import them into your game

Homebrew.NoItemsToExport: No items to export. Create some homebrew content first!
Homebrew.ExportFoldersDesc: Pick the folders holding your homebrew. The items are written as individual JSON files (laid out like the system's own pack sources, src/packs/homebrew/) into a timestamped folder in your world: worlds/<world>/homebrew-exports/. Linked powers/abilities are included automatically. Perfect for submitting content to be added to the system's Homebrew compendium.
Homebrew.NoFoldersFound: No folders with homebrew items found.
Homebrew.ImportContentDesc: Import homebrew content from JSON files created by you or shared by others.
Homebrew.ImportStep2: Select a valid homebrew JSON file from your computer
Homebrew.ImportStep3: Review the items to be imported
Homebrew.ImportStep4: Click "Import" to add them to your world
Homebrew.ImportWarning: Note: Imported items will be added to your world. If an item with the same name exists, it will be overwritten.
Homebrew.LoadExistingItemDesc: Select an existing item from your world to load into the editor for modification or duplication.
Homebrew.LoadIntoEditorDesc: This will load the item's data into the corresponding creation tab. You can then modify it and save as a new item or update the original.
Homebrew.FormatGuide1: All exports are in JSON format for easy sharing and version control.
Homebrew.FormatGuide2: Exported files are automatically named with timestamps (e.g., cain-homebrew-2024-01-15.json)
Homebrew.FormatGuide3: Exported files can be imported into any CAIN world using this system.
Homebrew.FormatGuide4: Share your JSON files with other GMs via Discord, Google Drive, or any file-sharing service.
Homebrew.DefaultSaveLocationsDesc: Choose where to save each type of homebrew item. Items will be organized in subfolders within the selected folder.
Homebrew.DefaultImportFolderHint: This folder will be used when importing items, unless you select a different folder during import.

SendMinions.Name: Send minions
SendMinions.Desc: Send traces or minions after the exorcists. They show up unexpectedly!

Ambush.Name: Ambush the exorcists
Ambush.Desc: The sin attacks directly with surprise. If fought, banished at 4 slashes.

Authorities.Name: Involve authorities
Authorities.Desc: Alert police, security, or military to the exorcists' activities.

Separate.Name: Separate someone
Separate.Desc: Send an exorcist or NPC somewhere dangerous. Force the party to split.

Choice.Name: Force a difficult choice
Choice.Desc: Make them choose between two things they need. Take the other away.

Escalate.Name: Escalate the situation
Escalate.Desc: Punch up tension dramatically. Conversation becomes arrest, car ride becomes chase.

Afflict.Name: Afflict the exorcists
Afflict.Desc: Give a random affliction from the sin sheet, or a harmful hook.

Clock.Name: Start/progress a ticking clock
Clock.Desc: Create urgency: bomb timer, poison, trapped civilians. 2-3 segments = short, 4+ = long.

Domain.Name: Use a domain
Domain.Desc: Activate a domain-specific tension move. Check the Sin's domains.

Npc.Name: Threaten or twist an NPC
Npc.Desc: Put crosshairs on an NPC. Pull the trigger if exorcists don't react.

Obstacle.Name: Introduce a new obstacle
Obstacle.Desc: Block the path: police, security systems, locked doors, monsters.

SIN.DESCRIPTIONPLACEHOLDER: Add a description of what your marks look like...
SIN.INTRO: A sin mark is a physical manifestation of wild power overflow on your body, evidence of your partial transformation into a sin. You can find a list of sin marks, their effects, and their table, on pg. 86. A sin mark is a new, permanent part of your character. It grants new, beneficial power, and grants you new abilities.

AnimatedTalismans.Name: Animated Talisman Slashes
AnimatedTalismans.Hint: Draw talisman slashes as animated brush strokes placed where you click, instead of swapping between pre-rendered images. Applies to the whole world; marks are tracked the same way either way, so this can be toggled freely.

TalismanEffectQuality.Name: Talisman Effect Quality
TalismanEffectQuality.Hint: Visual effect level for talisman animations on this computer. "Reduced" swaps the heavier effects for simple fades; "None" disables the transient animations entirely.
